{{Quote|Sir, sensors triggered in hangar 718. We are searching the area.|Unidentified First Order stormtrooper, to Kylo Ren|<ref name="TFA" />}}
A '''human'''<ref name="ECUC" /> served as one of the [[First Order]]'s [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] assigned to [[Starkiller Base]]. They reported a [[sensor]] trigger in [[Hangar 718]] to [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] and sent additional [[trooper]]s to investigate.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
This stormtrooper was voiced by [[Verona Blue]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. [[Matthew Wood]] confirmed Blue's role in a post on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Voices">{{SW|url=news/from-blast-that-x-wing-to-traitor-the-voices-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=From "Blast That X-wing!" to "Traitor!": The Voices of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''}}</ref>
